'''''Lantana involucrata''''', commonly known as '''buttonsage''', is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the [[Verbenaceae|verbena family]]. It is native to the [[Neotropical realm]], where it is widespread in well-drained areas.<ref>http://www.fs.fed.us/global/iitf/pdf/shrubs/Lantana%20involucrata.pdf ''Lantana involucrata'' at the US Forest Service</ref>

==Etymology==
The name ''Lantana'' derives from the [[Latin]] name of the wayfaring tree ''[[Viburnum lantana]]'', the flowers of which superficially resemble ''Lantana''.<ref name="gledhill">Gledhill, David (2008). "The Names of Plants". Cambridge University Press. {{ISBN|9780521866453}} (hardback), {{ISBN|9780521685535}} (paperback).  pp 230</ref>

==Description==
The plant blooms and fruits all year long[https://www.fnps.org/plant/lantana-involucrata].
